name: carmen-business-web
description: Static course and book storefront for Carmen

scripts.start: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 8080 -d dist
scripts.test: node --test tests/site.test.js tests/build.test.mts tests/payfast.test.mts tests/email.test.mts tests/repo.test.js
scripts.db:types: supabase gen types typescript --local --schema public > types/database.ts
scripts.test:db: npm run db:lint && supabase test db && node --test tests/db.api.test.js tests/functions.test.mts tests/itn.test.mts tests/download.test.mts tests/outbox.test.mts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:db && npm run build && npm run test:build && npm run test:e2e
